displayName: [Preview]: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra data centers should use customer-managed keys to encrypt disks and backup storage
description: Use customer-managed keys to manage encryption at rest for managed disks and backup storage in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra data centers. Customer-managed keys enable data to be encrypted with Azure Key Vault keys that you own and manage.

metadata.description: Enable or disable the execution of the policy.
